style: Realistic editorial photograph, natural daylight from a side window with soft fill, 35 mm lens at eye level, shallow depth of field, calm warm-neutral palette with muted greens and oak tones, lightly lived-in but tidy. No text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand marks or watermarks anywhere in the frame. No recognizable real or famous people; any person is seen from behind, in profile at a distance or cropped so the face is not identifiable.

shots.prompt: A farrier trims the hoof of a calm dairy cow standing in a clean, bright barn aisle with straw bedding. The cow's hind leg is lifted and held in a padded trimming crate; hoof knife and rasp lie on a wooden stool. Only the farrier's hands, forearms and work apron are visible.

alt.pl: Werkowanie racic krowy w jasnej oborze
alt.en: Trimming a cow's hooves in a bright barn

shots.prompt: An empty, calm consultation room in a small private practice: a desk with a closed laptop, two chairs facing each other, an examination couch with a paper sheet, a plant by the window and a neat shelf with unlabeled boxes.

alt.pl: Spokojny gabinet konsultacyjny z biurkiem i leżanką
alt.en: Calm consultation room with a desk and an examination couch

shots.prompt: A tidy small workshop bench: a vise, hand tools hanging on a pegboard, a half-finished wooden part clamped for sanding, fine sawdust in the light. A craftsperson's hands and forearms work at the edge of the frame.

alt.pl: Stół warsztatowy z narzędziami i obrabianym elementem
alt.en: Workshop bench with tools and a part being finished

shots.prompt: A bright small-business studio: an oak meeting table with a laptop, notebooks and two cups of coffee, linen chairs, large plants and a whiteboard with abstract colored shapes only, seen from the doorway.

alt.pl: Jasne studio z dębowym stołem spotkań
alt.en: Bright studio with an oak meeting table

shots.prompt: A plain, unbranded ceramic product - a matte glazed jug - on a linen cloth on an oak surface, with a sprig of dried grass beside it, against a soft off-white wall.
